name: policy_id
description: Stable identifier for the policy row.

name: entity_type
description: Restricts the policy to 'video' or 'channel'. NULL matches any entity type.

name: source
description: Restricts the policy to one detection source. NULL matches any source.

name: detector
description: Restricts the policy to one detector. NULL matches any detector.

name: taxonomy_prefix
description: Prefix-matched against detection.taxonomy, so 'advertiser_blocklist.' covers the whole subtree. NULL matches any taxonomy.

name: min_score
description: Minimum detector score for the policy to apply. NULL means no threshold, which is what deterministic detectors need.

name: action
description: What to do with matching detections: 'exclude', 'shadow', 'review' or 'ignore'.

name: priority
description: Where several policies match the same detection, the highest priority wins.

name: enabled
description: Whether the policy is in force. Disabling is preferred over deleting.

name: notes
description: Free text explaining why the policy exists.
